protocol.storage: Original E4M3FN x numeric BF16 128x128 scale in F32, then BF16 RNE; no reciprocal/E8M0 conversion

precision.parameters: BF16 including once-rounded native F32 GDN A_log/norm

partitions.attention: contiguous whole query+gate heads; whole KV heads; local native HF normalization/RoPE/attention; O input-column shards
partitions.gdn: local Q segment + local K segment + local V segment; matching depthwise conv; contiguous whole Z/B/A/value heads; local head-group repeat and norm; F32 per-rank state; output input-column shards
partitions.mlp: each rank has a slice of every expert, gate/up independently row-sharded then concatenated gate-before-up; down input-column shard
partitions.embedding_and_final_norm: replicated semantics; one computation on identical post-reduction hidden states
partitions.output: contiguous BF16 vocab row shards; concatenate rank0 then rank1 without reduction; actual vocab 248320 divisible by TP2, no padded vocab values exported; ragged/padded gather checked on independent 11-token fixture

protocol.reduction: Each local partial writes BF16; rank0.float + rank1.float; one BF16 RNE cast

moe.expert_execution: all experts logically resident/available on both ranks; lazy checkpoint operands allowed; not a measured residency/performance result
moe.routing: replicated original BF16 weights; native F32 full softmax/topk/renormalization; lower expert ID substitutions ONLY at equal raw logits; unequal raw softmax collisions stay native
moe.accumulation: pinned HF eager ascending expert ID, per-expert F32 routing product cast BF16 and BF16 index_add; NOT slot-major or fused F32 accumulation
moe.combine: native shared sigmoid BF16 gating; local routed+shared BF16 add; exactly ONE TP sum afterwards

protocol.continuation: own greedy full-vocab argmax after prefill; consumer MUST use recorded decode input; baseline drift skips same-input claims when continuations differ

comparison.state: report exactness AND unchanged tolerance, no a-priori CPU/CUDA state or exp equivalence claim
comparison.all_boundaries_required: all except oracle-only pre-canonicalization native_expert_ids; canonical selected IDs remain exact

protocol.custody: existing paper launch_guard seal/authenticate + test_vllm_qwen35.run_process subreaper; fresh explicit sole-owner grant and shared owner lock; never signal foreign PIDs
protocol.admission: CPU tests and a completed reference are NOT factory enablement or a Ferrule full40 PASS; caller must provide reference directory and manifest SHA256 to the runtime gate
unvalidated_math_sites: CUDA GEMM/softmax/norm/SiLU/sigmoid/reduction implementation drift versus production
HF GDN chunk prefill versus production recurrence/chunk policy, exp/softplus/L2 normalization and exact F32 state updates
HF eager per-expert accumulation versus vLLM fused MoE (different contract; no bit-exact claim)
protocol.blocker_policy: Any uncovered math-site difference or failed unchanged tolerance blocks runtime admission; no silent policy or threshold change
protocol.pre_weight_gate: Mandatory authenticated one-GPU synthetic TP1/native equality, TP2 GQA/GDN inventory, independent frozen row/local-MoE/route/head and CUDA-F32-state fixtures; abort before full checkpoint reads on failure

execution.transport: rank-order Torch simulation on one granted device; no NCCL/transport/performance proof

runtime_gate.requires: caller-supplied reference path plus SHA256 and fresh Ferrule full40 comparison

open_claims: No full40 Ferrule equivalence until caller compares every required tensor

replacements: two native local attention calls + sum/cache assembly
two native local MoE calls + sum
interception_audit.simulation: two logical ranks on one granted CUDA device; no NCCL or performance claim
interception_audit.routed_order: HF ascending expert ID; each F32 weighted product cast BF16 then BF16 index_add

loading_evidence.loader: save_pretrained mixed native BF16/F32 state_dict -> from_pretrained(dtype=torch.bfloat16)
loading_evidence.baseline: decoded-storage native eager BF16 model, NOT the HF dynamic-FP8 quantizer
loading_evidence.ssm_policy: F32 explicitly preallocated; NOT the HF default cache dtype

checkpoint.hash_scope: all original indexed shard files, including unused experts/vision/MTP

plan.capture: every call; complete old inventory at stage call; cache reflects committed post-call state
plan.fork: deep independent HF global/rank cache snapshots, not a runtime COW implementation
plan.cold_owner: one fresh authenticated numerical child per launch; repeat in a second launch to establish different owner identity
plan.stop: fixed bounded decode count, including EOS; not natural-stop quality/performance evaluation

suite.owner_scope: fresh child; process identity in numerical-authentication.json

marshal_diagnostic_only.policy: Python marshal serializes object-sharing references; canonical bytecode/source identity is the acceptance check

host_memory_policy: lazy one-tensor reads; no all-model GPU residency; peak RSS reported, not a hard partition
